title: A GitHub issue template and a skill let an agent write a clone's findings for upstream as user stories in one issue body
goal: .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/upstream-report.yml is an issue form whose fields hold user stories (title, goal, premise or repro, the local change made meanwhile, the clone's scope); backlog.py upstream-report ID... --out FILE writes the clone's own items as an issue body in that form's sections; the kb-upstream-report skill has an agent turn the operator's findings into those items and the file, then tells the operator to paste it into a new issue or run gh issue create --body-file themselves; nothing it runs posts to GitHub

run:
import json,os,re,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile
B=os.path.abspath('_tools/backlog.py');T='.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/upstream-report.yml'
labels=re.findall(r'^\s*label:\s*["\']?(.+?)["\']?\s*$',open(T,encoding='utf-8').read(),re.M) if os.path.exists(T) else []
t=tempfile.mkdtemp();u=os.path.join(t,'up');c=os.path.join(t,'team');f=os.path.join(t,'report.md')
g=lambda d,*a:s.run(['git','-C',d,*a],capture_output=True,text=True)
b=lambda d,*a:s.run([sys.executable,B,'--root',d,*a],capture_output=True,text=True)
os.makedirs(u);g(u,'init','-q','-b','main');open(os.path.join(u,'backlog.json'),'w').write(json.dumps({'item_dir':'items'}))
g(u,'add','-A');g(u,'-c','user.name=t','-c','user.email=t@example.com','commit','-qm','up')
s.run(['git','clone','-q',u,c]);g(c,'remote','rename','origin','upstream');g(c,'config','kb.upstreamRemote','upstream');g(c,'config','kb.scope','team')
n=b(c,'new','story','--title','planted field finding for upstream','--goal','planted goal text')
iid=(re.findall(r'ST-[a-z0-9]{8}',n.stdout) or [''])[0]
r=b(c,'upstream-report',iid,'--out',f)
body=open(f,encoding='utf-8').read() if os.path.exists(f) else ''
ok=bool(labels) and bool(iid) and r.returncode==0 and 'planted field finding for upstream' in body and all(l in body for l in labels)
STEP='report'
if ok and STEP=='import':
    i=b(u,'upstream-import',f,'--issue','https://github.com/example/it-ops-kb/issues/1');l=b(u,'list')
    items=[json.load(open(os.path.join(u,'items',x))) for x in os.listdir(os.path.join(u,'items'))] if os.path.isdir(os.path.join(u,'items')) else []
    ok=i.returncode==0 and 'planted field finding for upstream' in l.stdout and any('issues/1' in ' '.join(x.get('links',[])) and x.get('status')=='draft' for x in items)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

import sys,os;p='.claude/skills/kb-upstream-report/SKILL.md';t=open(p,encoding='utf-8').read() if os.path.exists(p) else '';sys.exit(0 if 'upstream-report' in t and 'user stor' in t and 'gh issue create' in t else 1)

notes: Operator's answer 2026-10-19: findings go back as a GitHub issue whose template the agent fills with user stories; how the issue is added (paste the file or automation) is the user's choice, so the tool writes a file and posts nothing. Premise: no template (.github holds only workflows) and no upstream-report command; the check exits 1 on the base. Today's field report (Windows ceiling, workspace .mcp.json, hand-made upstream remote and .venv) is the first planted case worth a dry run.
